location_anchors.prompt_summary: The orbital blockade zone above a massive golden-hued gas giant. It is dominated by kilometers-long dreadnoughts with architectural tiered superstructures, heavy weapon batteries, and vast hangar chasms. Space is filled with defense beams, flak explosions, and glowing engine particles under high-contrast solar glares and sharp, dark shadows.

prop_anchors.prompt_summary: A sleek, highly maneuverable interceptor with glowing cyan twin-engine trails. The hull is composed of matte carbon-fiber composites and reflective silver accents, acting as a microscopic speck of movement against giant structures.
